assumptions.zero_conv: motion + zero_initialized_1x1(motion), identity residual prevents V0 dead path; NOT confirmed by author
assumptions.flow_layout: three consecutive forward two-channel flows stacked as6channels
assumptions.future_motion: FlowNet2(last_RGB,predicted_future_RGB), frozen weights, gradients to RGB prediction
assumptions.flow_scaling: pixel displacement at256x256, no additional scaling
assumptions.memory: uniform initialization, Adam backpropagation, no explicit external update
assumptions.architecture: V0 Figure2-level reconstruction; exact kernels/biases not official
assumptions.losses: five unweighted terms, mean reductions, spatial channel cosine
assumptions.source_parameters: SHT Gaussian3/sigma5 and MRCA unchanged on both targets
assumptions.training: 10complete source epochs,batch4,epoch cosine; unspecified in accessible paper
assumptions.scoring: 3levels error-map average pyramid,16patch stride1,max at each level,sum->PSNR,video minmax,Gaussian sigma2 edge padding; unpublished constants fixed before target evaluation
assumptions.first_frames: discard first4 per video; no cross-video clips
assumptions.teacher_backend: same FlowNet2 weights/network, PyTorch operator port; no bitwise CUDA-kernel equivalence claim
